page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg5.3xlarge is a high-clock-speed computing instance belonging to the hfg5 family, deployed via KVM virtualization. The instance is powered by an Intel Xeon 6149 processor operating at a nominal base frequency of 3.1 GHz. Hardware resource allocation includes 12 dedicated vCPUs spread across 6 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading, supported by 22 MB of Level 3 cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and 32 KB of L1 data cache. The architecture supports x86_64 instruction extensions including AVX-512 and AES-NI.

The instance is configured with 48.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 4.0 GB per vCPU distribution. Memory throughput metrics show average uncached read performance at 56.31 GB/sec and uncached write performance at 39.44 GB/sec. Synthetic memory benchmarks show moderate performance, with PassMark memory scoring in the lower quartile. The instance does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU accelerators, requiring external block storage for persistent volumes. Baseline network connectivity is rated at 2 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are attached.

Benchmark testing reflects balanced multi-threaded throughput paired with modest single-core execution speeds. Geekbench multi-core registers at 5452 points and stress-ng multi-core reaches 10812.38, whereas single-core metrics fall into lower performance brackets across Geekbench, stress-ng, and single-threaded gzip compression. Application-level evaluations indicate solid middle-tier results, reaching 10.75 million operations per second on Redis SET workloads, 6.37 GB/sec static web serving throughput, and steady Clang compilation scores.

Given its hardware distribution and performance characteristics, ecs.hfg5.3xlarge serves multi-threaded enterprise workloads requiring dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory without local disk requirements. Effective deployments include web application serving, Redis caching tiers, CI/CD compilation runners, and intermediate batch processing pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg5.3xlarge is a dedicated KVM-based compute instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6149 processor running at 3.1 GHz. It features 12 vCPUs across 6 physical cores with multithreading, alongside 48.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. The configuration includes AVX-512 extensions, 22 MB of L3 cache, a 2 Gbps baseline network interface, and no bundled local storage or GPU hardware. Performance metrics demonstrate consistent mid-tier multi-threaded compute and caching capabilities, achieving 10.75 million operations per second in Redis SET operations and steady software compilation speeds, offset by weaker single-threaded execution scores. Lacking local storage, it relies on network storage solutions. This profile makes ecs.hfg5.3xlarge suitable for containerized web services, distributed caching clusters, build servers, and general business applications requiring predictable compute allocation.
